51355349.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human CSE by ITC analysis
51355349.references_previous: Reference 25: Purich, D. L. Enzyme Kinetics Catalysis and Control. First edition ed.; Elsevier Inc.: London, 2010; p 485-537.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The human CSE protein (10 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the inhibitor (NSC4056, 100 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The buffer used was 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) containing 150 mM NaCl and 1 mM DTT. The experiment was performed with 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a spacing of 120 s between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using the Origin software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The control experiment was performed by titrating the inhibitor into the buffer without the protein.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Structural basis of NSC4056 for the inhibition of hCSE. (A) NSC4056 inhibits hCSE in a reversible manner. (B) Isothermal titration calorimetry assay to confirm the direct binding between NSC4056 and hCSE. Upper panel, raw data; lower panel, the releasing heat was fitted into the single binding site model. (C) Inhibition of hCSE by NSC4056 as a function of PLP concentration (0.39, 0.78, 1.57, 3.125, 6.25, 12.5, 15 μM) with L-Cys (20 μM) as a substrate (non-competitive inhibition αk = 4.2 ± 0.5 μM). (D) Inhibition of hCSE by NSC4056 as a function of L-Cys concentration in the presence of PLP (100 μM) (competitive inhibition constant Ki = 0.6 ± 0.2 μM). (E) The putative binding mode of NSC4056 in the hCSE active site. NSC4056 was docked into the hCSE crystal structure (PDB code 3COG) using the Discovery Studio software. (F) Dose-dependent inhibition of NSC4056 on hCSE WT or mutants. Mean ± S.D. (n = 4 for A and F; n=2 for C–D).
original_paragraph.Results and Discussion: The reversibility of their inhibition was studied by diluting the enzyme-plus-inhibitor solutions with assay buffer.25 As shown in Figure 2A, the inhibition effect of NSC4056 could be reversed with a 200-fold dilution, indicating that NSC4056 is a non-covalent inhibitor of CSE. Moreover, the dissociation constant (Kd) and stoichiometry (N) of NSC4056 binding to hCSE were determined to be 3.4 μM and 1.08 by isothermal titration calorimetry assay (ITC), respectively (Figure 2B), indicating that NSC4056 specifically binds to one site of hCSE.

assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of inhibitor into buffer without the protein
